properties.name: name
properties.description: Unique tab identity. Changing the names or their order remounts the pager.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Optional tab-bar icon. The default bar supplies its tint through `color` and `tintColor`.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible and accessible label. With no label, the default bar shows `name` only when no icon is supplied; its accessible label always falls back to `name`.

properties.name: badge
properties.description:
Badge shown on this tab in the default tab bar. A string or number renders
as a count bubble; `true` renders a small dot, and `false` hides it. Custom tab bars receive it
on their `TabConfig` and can render it however they like.

properties.name: tabs
properties.description: Tab metadata in page order.

properties.name: scrollY
properties.description: Active page's mirrored offset; negative values represent overscroll.

properties.name: perPageScrollY
properties.description:
Tracked offsets for each page. Custom chrome should also account for
`scrollToTopOffset` during re-taps and negative `scrollY` during a stretched pull.

properties.name: scrollToTopIndex
properties.description:
Active during same-tab scroll-to-top so header chrome can follow the
UI-thread driven target instead of waiting on native scroll events.

properties.name: scrollToTopOffset
properties.description: Animated offset to read while `scrollToTopIndex` matches the active page.

properties.name: tabCount
properties.description: Number of pages.

properties.name: headerHeight
properties.description: Collapsible header height, initially estimated and then measured.

properties.name: activeIndex
properties.description: Selected target index; changes before a paging animation finishes.

properties.name: pagerOffset
properties.description: Fractional visual page position, clamped to the first and last pages.

properties.name: pillWidth
properties.description: Width of one equal-width tab slot, measured by the default tab bar.

properties.name: pinnedHeaderHeight
properties.description: Pinned header height, excluding `topInset`.

properties.name: tabBarHeight
properties.description: Reserved tab bar height. Custom tab bars should fit this height.

properties.name: topInset
properties.description: Reserved top inset.

properties.name: minHeaderHeight
properties.description: Minimum visible height of the collapsible header once chrome collapse finishes.

properties.name: pullDownBehavior
properties.description: Chrome behavior while the list is pulled below its start.

properties.name: onTabPress
properties.description: Select a page, or scroll the selected page to its top when enabled.

properties.name: damping
properties.description: Spring damping. Defaults to 30.

properties.name: stiffness
properties.description: Spring stiffness. Defaults to 200.

properties.name: mass
properties.description: Spring mass. Defaults to 1.

properties.name: overshootClamping
properties.description: Stop the spring at its target without overshooting. Defaults to true.

properties.name: scrollY
properties.description: Active page's scroll position; negative values represent overscroll.

properties.name: headerHeight
properties.description: Collapsible header height, initially estimated and then measured.

properties.name: topInset
properties.description: Reserved top inset. Apply it as padding inside the pinned header if needed.

properties.name: pinnedHeaderHeight
properties.description: Pinned header height, excluding `topInset`.

properties.name: children
properties.description: One or more Tabs.Tab elements. Changing tab names, count, or order resets pager and page state.

properties.name: renderHeader
properties.description: Collapsible header rendered above the tab bar. Its height is measured automatically.

properties.name: renderPinnedHeader
properties.description: Fixed top header. Its content should include any desired padding for `topInset`.

properties.name: pinnedHeaderHeight
properties.description:
Height of the pinned header, excluding the safe-area top inset (which is
added to the wrapper's height). Omit it to measure the rendered pinned
header, including its own top-inset padding, then subtract that inset.
An explicit height avoids the first-frame measurement adjustment.

properties.name: topInset
properties.description:
Top inset reserved by the container. Defaults to the device safe-area
inset. Set to 0 to let chrome and content reach the status-bar/notch area,
or when an ancestor already handles that inset. Negative values clamp to 0;
non-finite values fall back to the device inset.

properties.name: minHeaderHeight
properties.description:
Minimum height of the collapsible header left visible after scrolling.
The tab bar stops below this strip instead of under the top inset alone.
Defaults to 0 (header may collapse fully). Clamped to the measured header height.

properties.name: tabBarHeight
properties.description: Reserved tab bar height in layout units. Defaults to 56.

properties.name: initialIndex
properties.description: Tab to start on. Defaults to 0; rounded and clamped to the available pages. Read once at mount.

properties.name: index
properties.description:
Controlled active tab: a new external value navigates to that tab.
Gestures and taps still move the pager directly and report via
`onIndexChange` — commit that value back to your state to keep the pair
in sync. An echoed report acknowledges navigation without restarting it
or undoing a newer swipe. Omit it (or pass `undefined`)
for uncontrolled behavior driven by `initialIndex`, gestures, and the
imperative ref.

properties.name: onIndexChange
properties.description:
Reports the selected navigation target without waiting for animation
completion. Gesture notifications reach React asynchronously; obsolete
queued notifications may be coalesced during rapid navigation.

properties.name: scrollToTopOnTabPress
properties.description:
Tapping the already-active tab scrolls its list back to the top (the X
behavior). Defaults to `true`; set `false` to make re-taps inert.

properties.name: renderTabBar
properties.description: Custom tab bar; omit for the default pill bar, or return null to hide it. Set tabBarHeight to 0 to remove its reserved space.

properties.name: containerStyle
properties.description: Style for the outer container. Give it a bounded width and height.

properties.name: swipeEnabled
properties.description: Enable horizontal paging gestures. Defaults to true; tab presses and ref navigation still work when false.

properties.name: headerScrollEnabled
properties.description: Allow vertical dragging on the collapsible header and tab bar. Defaults to true.

properties.name: swipeActivationDistance
properties.description: Minimum horizontal travel before the direction rule can select paging. Defaults to 15 dp.

properties.name: swipeFailDistance
properties.description: Minimum vertical travel before a clearly vertical drag yields to scrolling. Defaults to 10 dp.

properties.name: swipeDirectionRatio
properties.description:
Required dominance of one axis over the other. Defaults to 1.4; values
below 1 are clamped to 1. Ambiguous diagonals yield to scrolling after
twice the larger activation distance. Direction locks until release.

properties.name: momentumSwipeFailDistance
properties.deprecated:
Ignored. Direction recognition now uses the same ratio and
distances during momentum as at rest. Use swipeDirectionRatio,
swipeActivationDistance and swipeFailDistance to tune recognition.

properties.name: swipeGestureTopInset
properties.description:
Top area where the horizontal pager pan should not activate. `'auto'`
(default) follows the currently visible pinned header, safe-area inset,
collapsible header, and tab bar. A number reserves a fixed area instead.
Pass `0` to allow pager swipes from the full page height.

properties.name: springConfig
properties.description: Spring for gesture releases. Programmatic navigation uses a timing animation.

properties.name: minPageContentHeight
properties.description:
Minimum content height per page, so short or empty pages can still
scroll far enough to hold the fully-collapsed chrome. Defaults to the
measured container height plus the measured header height. Longer content
can scroll further. Per-list `minContentHeight` overrides it for one page.

properties.name: estimatedHeaderHeight
properties.description:
Optional first-frame estimate for the collapsible header height. The real
measured height still wins after layout, but this keeps list spacers from
starting at 0 and jumping on the first scroll.

properties.name: lazy
properties.description:
Lazily mount tab pages as they are visited. Mounted tabs stay mounted so
scroll state is preserved when returning to a tab. Defaults to false.

properties.name: lazyPreloadDistance
properties.description:
Number of neighboring tabs to mount before they are visited when `lazy` is
enabled. Defaults to 1 so adjacent swipe targets are ready.

properties.name: pullDownBehavior
properties.description:
How the page behaves on pull-down at the top.

- `'stretch'` — the whole page rides down with the pull: the collapsible
  header and tab bar translate down while the pinned header stays put,
  revealing the refresh indicator near the top of the screen. On iOS
  this rides the native bounce with the native RefreshControl. Android
  has no native bounce, so the Container drives the pull itself: the
  native SwipeRefreshLayout is suppressed and a built-in indicator is
  shown instead — your `refreshControl` element's `refreshing` and
  `onRefresh` still drive it, no API change.
- `'static'` (default) — chrome stays put; the native RefreshControl
  appears between the header chrome and the list content on both
  platforms (`progressViewOffset` is injected automatically; pass your
  own to override). iOS stretch mode offsets its native indicator below
  the pinned header and top inset. Android stretch uses a built-in
  indicator and does not apply native indicator styling props.

The web wrappers do not implement native pull-to-refresh gestures.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Page content, normally one coordinated list wrapper.

properties.name: setIndex
properties.description: Move to a tab, animated by default. Indices round and clamp; non-finite values select 0. Reports through onIndexChange.

properties.name: getIndex
properties.description: Current selected target index, even while its animation is settling.

properties.name: scrollY
properties.description: Active page's scroll position (shared value).

properties.name: headerHeight
properties.description: Collapsing-header height: the initial estimate until layout provides a measurement. Zero without a header.

properties.name: collapseProgress
properties.description: 0 = fully expanded, 1 = fully collapsed (derived, clamped). Remains 0 when header height is 0.

properties.name: pinnedHeaderHeight
properties.description: Pinned header height (excludes the safe-area top inset).

properties.name: tabBarHeight
properties.description: Tab bar height.

properties.name: topInset
properties.description: Reserved top inset (the device safe area unless Container.topInset overrides it).

properties.name: minHeaderHeight
properties.description: Minimum visible collapsible header height after chrome collapse.

properties.name: contentTop
properties.description:
Fixed chrome height when the collapsing header is fully collapsed
(pinned header + top inset + min header + tab bar). Handy for positioning a
custom sticky element or a RefreshControl.

properties.name: background
properties.description: Background of the tab bar.

properties.name: trackBackground
properties.description: Track color behind the pill.

properties.name: pillBackground
properties.description: Color of the moving pill behind the active tab.

properties.name: iconTint
properties.description: Tint supplied to icon elements through both `color` and `tintColor`.

properties.name: labelColor
properties.description: Color used for label text.

properties.name: badgeBackground
properties.description: Background of the tab badge bubble/dot.

properties.name: badgeText
properties.description: Color of the badge count text.

properties.name: colors
properties.description: Overrides for the default light tab-bar palette.

properties.name: sidePadding
properties.description: Side padding inside the pill container. Default 16.

properties.name: minTabWidth
properties.description:
Minimum width an equal-width tab may shrink to before the bar switches to
its horizontally scrollable, content-width layout. Default 88.
Only consulted when `scrollable` is `'auto'`.

properties.name: scrollable
properties.description:
Layout mode. `'auto'` (default) uses an equal-width pill when the tabs fit
and a scrollable content-width pill when they'd be narrower than
`minTabWidth`. `true` forces the scrollable layout; `false` forces
equal-width (tabs may get cramped).

properties.name: onMeasure
properties.type: (index: number, x: number, width: number) => void
properties.description: When provided, the button reports its layout and uses content width.
